findings.finding: Share count / dilution mismatch between the narrative and the execution. drivers.sbc_pct.reason says 'dilution of about +1% a year in diluted shares is carried in the share count', but the executed forecast holds shares flat at 384,988,173 for all five years (scenario_reasons ...condition.drivers.shares change 0.0), and the opening uses the basic cover count while the Q1/Q2 2026 releases and 10-Q show 9.2m / ~8.2m potential dilutive equity awards (diluted 392.7m vs basic 384.6m in Q2 2026, about 2%). Per-share values are overstated by about 2% and the stated dilution is not executed.
findings.where: evidence_pack.json drivers.sbc_pct.reason; casefile.json val.case.assumptions[id=dilution], val.case.opening.shares; reading/10q_2026-07-29.txt line 170; reading/release_2026-04-22 line 398
findings.fix: Either add the in-the-money dilutive awards (treasury method, ~7.8-9.2m) to the opening share count or remove the '+1% a year carried in the share count' sentence from sbc_pct.reason so it matches the executed flat count; state the choice in the dilution assumption.

findings.finding: Asymmetric post-balance-sheet bridge. forecast_options.debt_like_claims subtracts the UIG upfront cash (1.45bn, paid after 2026-06-30) as debt, but the bridge assumption applies no other post-period events: Q3 2026 cash generation (FY2026 adjusted FCF guide 2.4-2.6bn less H1 ~1.58bn implies ~0.9bn in H2) is not credited, and UIG's revenue/earnings are excluded from every scenario (growth_anchor reason: 'its revenue is undisclosed, a gap'). The opening equity is therefore biased low by the purchase price while getting none of the acquired business; open_balance debt 4,624.4m = 2,939.8m balance-sheet debt + 1,684.6m claims.
findings.where: evidence_pack.json forecast_options.debt_like_claims[0]; casefile.json val.case.assumptions[id=bridge] and [id=open_balance]; drivers.growth_anchor.reason
findings.fix: Bridge consistently: either keep the 2026-06-30 balance unadjusted and treat UIG as a gap (no outflow, no earnings), or subtract the 1.45bn AND credit H2 cash generation per the guide and add a disclosed/estimated UIG contribution (or a visible gap row stating the direction of the bias).

findings.finding: Key risk row (shown in the table) misstates a number: 'הרווחיות היום בשיא של 6 שנים (19.5% ברבעון השני מול חציון 12.7%)'. 12.7% is the FY2023 GAAP operating margin (872.2/6,863.2), not a median. The six-year GAAP operating margins from the pack's own facts are FY2020 4.9%, FY2021 5.2%, FY2022 3.9%, FY2023 12.7%, FY2024 17.1%, FY2025 17.9%: median about 9.0%.
findings.fix: Replace 'מול חציון 12.7%' with 'מול חציון של כ־9% ב־2020–2025' (or 'מול 12.7% ב־2023') and keep the cited fact ids pf_operating_income_fy2020..fy2025 / pf_revenue_fy2020..fy2025.

findings.finding: Base and bull growth_anchor are labelled source_tier 'contracted', but the only contracted evidence is the 15.0bn backlog at 2025-12-31 (10-K); orders/backlog are no longer disclosed in 2026, and the 26% base rests on a Q4 2026 run rate derived from the FY2026 and Q3 guidance (guidance tier) while the bull 34% assumes orders keep the FY2025 pace (hypothesis). The tier overstates the evidence quality behind the largest driver.
findings.fix: Set base source_tier to 'guidance' (derived from rp_g_rev_fy26_jul / rp_g_rev_q3_26 with the 2025 backlog as support) and bull to 'hypothesis' or 'own_history', so the confidence and audit rows read the true tier.

findings.finding: MarketBeat pages that restate the company's own 2026-07-29 guidance (ex_mb_guid_20260729, ex_mb_q3g_20260729) are registered as kind consensus, independent true, with no syndicated_from; ex_key_20260730 (KeyCorp via MarketBeat) and ex_rbc_20260423 (RBC via Placera) are independent false but name no original. Only the consensus block cites them (no driver, event or key risk uses consensus: checked), so the effect is limited to the independent-source count (29).
findings.fix: Set independent false and syndicated_from (pf_rel_20260729_1 for the guidance restatements; 'KeyCorp research note' / 'RBC Capital Markets note' for the broker rows); keep only the analysts' estimate fields as consensus.

findings.finding: Yahoo Finance consensus rows (ex_c_*_yh, source ex_yh_an_20261027, dated 2026-10-27) are not citable until 2026-10-29 under LAG_DAYS=2, yet sit in the consensus block of the pack; they back no driver (the growth reason says so), so this is a labelling issue only.
findings.fix: Move these rows to notes as a cross-check gap ('not citable until 2026-10-29') or mark them non-citable in the consensus block.

findings.finding: The quote cites source id 'ib:snapshot', which is not a registered source; the registered IB snapshot is nm_ib_snapshot_20261028. The snapshot itself (raw/ib__price-snapshot-VRT__current.json: last 213.0, is_close false, ts 1793175237 = 2026-10-28 ~07:14 UTC) is a pre-market print on the Q3 results day, so it may already include the 2026-10-28 results that the drivers cannot cite (already in the run's gaps).
findings.fix: Cite nm_ib_snapshot_20261028 in the quote; keep the results-day pre-market caveat next to the table, or rerun with as_of 2026-10-30 and the regular-session close.

findings.finding: The base scenario text says the small net cash was 'כ-171 מיליון דולר ביוני 2026'; no fact in the pack carries 171m, and the 10-Q balance sheet gives cash 2,810.6m vs long-term debt 2,939.8m (net debt ~129m at carrying value; the release only says 'a net cash position' without a figure). The number is untraceable.
findings.fix: Cite the computation (cash less debt principal from the 10-Q debt note) with fact ids, or replace with the release wording ('מזומן נטו קטן, לפי החברה') without a figure.
